name: F/A-18E Super Hornet

serviceWindow.statusNotes: Initial operational capability September 2001 with VFA-115. Still in production and the backbone of US Navy carrier air wings as of the 2026-03-15 scenario date.

dimensions.crew: 1 (pilot). The two-seat F/A-18F adds a weapon systems officer.

propulsionSummary: Two General Electric F414-GE-400 afterburning turbofans, each rated at about 22,000 lbf (98 kN) with afterburner.

weapons.name: AIM-120C AMRAAM
weapons.mountSummary: Wingtip, wing and fuselage stations. The fighter-escort fit carries up to 7 AMRAAM plus 2 Sidewinders; the engine loadout counts 6.

weapons.name: AGM-84 Harpoon
weapons.mountSummary: Underwing stations. Two missiles is a typical maritime-strike count; the engine carries them alongside the AMRAAM load.

weapons.name: M61A1 Vulcan 20mm
weapons.mountSummary: Six-barrel 20 mm rotary cannon in the nose. Published magazine sizes differ by source and variant, so the round count is our figure.

sensors.name: AN/APG-79 AESA radar
sensors.role: Air-to-air search and track, simultaneous air-to-ground and sea-surface modes

sensors.name: AN/ALR-67(V)3 radar warning receiver
sensors.role: Passive detection of hostile radar emissions, with cueing to the jammer and countermeasure dispenser

sensors.name: AN/ASQ-228 ATFLIR targeting pod
sensors.role: Forward-looking infrared for navigation, target identification and laser designation

sensors.name: Pilot visual lookout
sensors.role: Visual identification of aircraft and ships in clear weather

loadouts.name: Strike, hi-lo-hi with three drop tanks
loadouts.role: Laser-guided bomb strike against land or ship targets

loadouts.name: Anti-ship strike with mixed air-to-air fit
loadouts.role: Harpoon attack on surface ships with fighter self-defence

radar.note: Not a stealth aircraft, but the angled engine inlets, serrated panel joints and aligned edges cut the radar return from the front and rear.

infrared.note: Two large afterburning turbofans give a strong heat source, especially from behind and when the afterburners light.

visual.note: A mid-size fighter at about 18 m long, easier to spot than a small trainer but not trailing heavy smoke.

brief.whatItIs: The F/A-18E Super Hornet is the US Navy's main carrier-based fighter. It is a single-seat, twin-engine jet that can shoot down other aircraft and also bomb ground targets or sink ships on the same sortie. It is a larger, longer-ranged development of the older F/A-18 Hornet.
brief.howItIsUsed: A commander keeps Super Hornets on deck as a flexible striking arm. In the air they fly escort for strike packages and patrol stations around the carrier group, using the AESA radar to see air targets far out and fire AMRAAM missiles before the enemy gets close. For a sea-control mission, two to four aircraft carry Harpoon anti-ship missiles and attack ships from beyond the range of most shipboard air defence. The aircraft is fast and agile but it is a conventional airframe, so its radar and infrared signatures are real. A pair flying low over open water stays hard to catch for an enemy with only gun or short-range defences, while a modern surface-to-air missile ship will still find it. Tanker aircraft and the carrier itself decide how far it can reach.
typicalMissions: Fleet air defence and fighter escort
Aerial refuelling of other carrier aircraft
